evidence_quote: Here we present the neurobehavioral findings of 3 siblings with genetically proven AOAD.
A GFAP gene test was performed, which revealed the same substitution as that observed in the mother pY242N.
note: Mother and son with the same GFAP variant.

evidence_quote: Given the clinical presentation, imaging findings, and biopsy report, a diagnosis of Alexander's disease (AD) was made.
note: Diagnosis by imaging and biopsy (Rosenthal fibers); no GFAP variant reported.

evidence_quote: Whole exome sequencing uncovered a novel heterozygous inframe deletion (p.Glu138\_Leu148del) in exon 1 of GFAP
note: Also has per-patient Tables 1-2 of earlier GFAP InDel and coil 1B cases plus functional assays.

evidence_quote: Despite "normal" GFAP sequencing, this patient had pathologically confirmed AxD.
note: Autopsy-confirmed AxD; the only GFAP variant reported (c.469G>A, p.D157N) is called likely benign, so has_genotype is a close call.

evidence_quote: Medullary signal abnormalities resembling the chipmunk sign were found more frequently in subjects with AxD (48/55, 87%) than in the comparison non-AxD leukodystrophy group (10/74, 14%; OR¼ 43.8; 95% CI, 15.5-123.6; P,.001).
note: Close: 55 GFAP-positive subjects reported only in aggregate in the text (an unnamed index subject's MRI sign aside); per-patient details are in the online supplement, not this file.
